text:
lina_cs: Seaborn Analytics just called: demo in 36h overloaded APAC edge. Asking for temporary QPS increase + allowlist of their demo host range (198.51.100.64/26). Renewal check in 5 weeks, want to avoid demo flub. Can ops assist?
tariq_ops: We can. Which APAC region do they prefer pinned?
mika_net: They requested singapore (ap-southeast-1). Provided two sample egress IPs: 198.51.100.70 and 198.51.100.71 please whitelist those and the /26.
lina_cs: Customer note pasted: "we expect bursts up to 600 rps for 2h, target soft QPS=3200 for window, please. We'll need a short summary of token usage after."
tariq_ops: Proposed: soft QPS=3200, hard QPS=4200, autorevoke @48h, 24h pre-revoke notice. Need eng-infra/edge approval for region pin + proxy ACL entries.
mika_net: Minimal action list for eng-infra: 1) add CIDR 198.51.100.64/26 to tenant allowlist 2) set tenant.seaborn soft qps=3200 hard qps=4200 3) schedule autorevoke at 48h 4) route peering to ap-southeast-1 5) smoke test from 198.51.100.70
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: draft change created: 2025-08-02T22:00:00Z status: pending-approval. Change summary: allowlist 198.51.100.64/26, tenant soft=3200 hard=4200, autorevoke=48h, region pin ap-southeast-1.
sophia_renewals: Flagging renewals: demo impact = high. If demo fails, renewal risk rises. I'll prep a short playbook entry to follow up.
billing-bot: billing-bot: noted. Will prepare a post-demo token-cost snapshot and estimate delta for customer-facing note.
mika_net: Quick validate curl to run after ACL applied:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 198.51.100.70" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expect 200.
tariq_ops: ENGOPS-5307 opened: "seaborn-analytics: ap-southeast-1 allowlist + temp qps bump" link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-5307
tariq_ops: Rollback triggers: sustained p50 latency > 450ms OR error rate > 1.5% over 2m -> revert limits and notify customer + CS. Also will collect traces for the window.
lina_cs: Customer asked for 24h notice before revoke and a short one-paragraph confirmation email after changes. Who owns the email?
mika_net: I can draft the confirmation and include the test snippet.
sophia_renewals: I'll add the demo outcome and any qualitative feedback to the renewal playbook immediately after.
tariq_ops: I'll post status updates when infra approves and after validation. If approvals block the window, we'll escalate to eng-infra pager. :rocket:
